Based on the visual evidence, the **active card is flush against the right edge**.

The layout appears **off-center and unbalanced**. The active card ("إجمالي المقياس") is aligned to the right, with the navigation arrows positioned to its left. There is no centering of the active card, nor is there a "peek" of the next card visible on the left side of the strip in this view.
